title: Prompt Less, Infer More: Static Analysis-Guided LLM Type Annotation for Python
abstract: arXiv:2610.41617v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Type annotations improve the maintainability and reliability of Python programs, but many real-world projects remain under-annotated because manual annotation is time-consuming and error-prone. Recent neural and LLM-based type inference systems can recover missing annotations, yet they often trade accuracy for efficiency. Existing approaches often fail to exploit project-wide type evidence, or do so inefficiently through unnecessary model calls and noisy prompts. We present SALT, an LLM-based type inference system guided by static analysis. SALT integrates static analysis with LLM inference to resolve types statically, prioritize LLM queries, and construct concise type-aware context. To demonstrate the effectiveness of SALT, we evaluated it on 12 real-world Python projects. translated_title: 更少提示，更多推断：基于静态分析引导的LLM Python类型标注
translated_abstract: 类型注解能够提升Python程序的可维护性和可靠性，但由于手动标注耗时且容易出错，许多真实世界的项目仍然缺乏足够的类型注解。近年来基于神经网络和LLM的类型推断系统虽然可以恢复缺失的注解，但它们往往以牺牲准确性来换取效率。现有方法常常未能充分利用项目范围内的类型证据，或者通过不必要的模型调用和冗余的提示低效地利用这些证据。我们提出了SALT，一个由静态分析引导的基于LLM的类型推断系统。SALT将静态分析与LLM推断相结合，以静态方式解析类型、对LLM查询进行优先级排序，并构建简洁的类型感知上下文。为了证明SALT的有效性，我们在12个真实的Python项目上对其进行了评估。SALT在所评估的系统中取得了最佳准确率，与强大的编码助手基线相比，估计的LLM成本最多降低78.5%。它还……
tldr: SALT是一个由静态分析引导的LLM类型推断系统，通过静态解析类型、优先排序LLM查询并构建简洁的类型感知上下文，在12个真实Python项目上实现了最佳类型标注准确率，同时将LLM调用成本最多降低78.5%。
en_tdlr: SALT is a static analysis-guided LLM type inference system that resolves types statically, prioritizes LLM queries, and constructs concise type-aware context, achieving the best annotation accuracy on 12 real-world Python projects while reducing LLM costs by up to 78.5%.
